svg.title: The warehouse from above with the zones, the field sets and the situations
svg.desc: A typical warehouse floor seen from above: the office and visitor route as Z5 excluded, a taped test area Z1, three rack rows with dashed aisle lanes as Z2, a dock lane Z3 with the robot's dock, a charging bay Z4, a truck loading dock as Z0 excluded; the robot in an aisle with the three FS-1 field lengths nested ahead of it, a carry ghost with FS-3 and FS-4, a docking ghost with the FS-2 lengths and the blind reverse path; a station bay with the workspace ring and lift keep-clear; the people of IS-01, IS-02, IS-04 and IS-13 where they happen, with hazard chips.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The warehouse from above: the zones of WP-C-02 §2 on a typical floor, the robot with every field set of WP-S-04 §4.1, the situations where they happen

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A fictional but typical site drawn by the generator; the zones, people classes, speeds, field lengths, rings and ratings are read from the tables. Field sets are nested at their planning lengths on the robot where each applies.

svg.text: Zones are WP-C-02 §2's; the loading dock, office and visitor route show what Z0 and Z5 look like on a real floor. Workers in vests are briefed staff, blue is the technician, grey a visitor. Chips: hazard, scenario, PLr adopted (WP-C-03 §5).

svg.text: The robot is its CAD rendered from above (assurance/sim/blender/sprites); the carry ghost is CFG-002 in the carry pose. Field lengths: WP-S-04 §4.1 planning values, C = 0; the coast is unmeasured (WP-V-02).
